summary: JAGS McCartney International Airport (GDT) is the main gateway to Grand Turk island in the Turks and Caicos Islands, a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean. Named after James Alexander George Smith McCartney, a prominent local political figure and former Chief Minister, the airport serves Cockburn Town, the territorial capital. While most visitors to Turks and Caicos arrive via Providenciales, GDT provides direct access to Grand Turk's historic sites, diving reefs, and laid-back island atmosphere.
faqs:
Q: Which airlines operate at JAGS McCartney International Airport?
A: InterCaribbean Airways and Caicos Express Airways provide scheduled service, primarily connecting Grand Turk with Providenciales and other Caribbean destinations.

Q: How far is the airport from Cockburn Town?
A: The airport is located just a few minutes' drive from Cockburn Town, with most accommodations on Grand Turk within a short taxi ride of the terminal.

Q: Does Grand Turk have its own immigration and customs facilities?
A: Yes, GDT has customs and immigration services for international arrivals, though the terminal is relatively small compared to Providenciales International Airport.

Q: Can I fly directly from the US to Grand Turk?
A: Direct service from the US is limited; most travelers connect through Providenciales (PLS) to reach Grand Turk.
transport_tips: Taxis are readily available outside the terminal and are the most common way to reach accommodations on Grand Turk. Rental cars and scooters can also be arranged, which is useful for exploring the small island at your own pace. There is no public bus service
